meta.title: The Neon Heist
meta.subtitle: 🌆 A powerful corporation controls the city. Tonight, you're breaking in.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🌌 Rooftop Entry
scenes.narrative:
🌧 Rain falls across neon rooftops as you crouch above the target building.

Below sits Helix Corp, the most feared corporation in the city.

💾 Your contact claims the data inside could change everything.

You have three ways in.

scenes.title: 🗑 Vent System
scenes.narrative:
You slide into the narrow vent system.

The metal creaks beneath you.

🎧 Voices echo below. Guards mention a lockdown protocol.

scenes.title: 🚪 Main Entrance
scenes.narrative:
You connect your device to the security panel.

💻 Heavy encryption pushes back against your hack.

Force it open, or stay quiet?

scenes.title: 🪜 Fire Escape
scenes.narrative:
You descend the fire escape and reach a side window.

Inside is a dark office floor lit only by glowing monitors.

scenes.title: 📹 Security Room
scenes.narrative:
Rows of monitors flicker across the room.

👮 One guard watches the screens, unaware you're behind them.

scenes.title: 🖥 Server Room
scenes.narrative:
Towering servers glow blue in the darkness.

💾 This is where the data is stored.

You can start the download now… or explore deeper.

scenes.title: 🏮 Lobby
scenes.narrative:
The doors slide open silently.

📷 Cameras track every movement as you cross the empty lobby.

scenes.title: 📄 Office Floor
scenes.narrative:
Cubicles stretch across the floor.

💡 A few monitors still glow in the darkness.

You spot employee credentials left on a desk.

scenes.title: 🔑 Basement Access
scenes.narrative:
You slip into the basement.

⚙️ Machinery hums in the darkness.

Then you hear something else move.

scenes.title: 🚶 Hallway
scenes.narrative:
You move through a long metal hallway.

👣 Footsteps echo nearby.

Security is getting closer.

scenes.title: 🎛 Control Access
scenes.narrative:
You gain access to Helix systems.

📡 Cameras, locks, and alarms are now under your control.

scenes.title: ⏳ Downloading...
scenes.narrative:
The files begin transferring.

⚠️ Suddenly, a warning flashes across the screen:

TRACE DETECTED.

scenes.title: 🧪 Hidden Lab
scenes.narrative:
You discover a hidden laboratory deep inside the building.

👁 Strange experiments line the walls.

Something alive moves behind the glass.

scenes.title: 🧬 Experiment Room
scenes.narrative:
A creature sits inside a containment pod.

👁 It slowly opens its eyes and stares directly at you.

scenes.title: ⬆️ Elevator
scenes.narrative:
The elevator hums quietly.

🏢 Top floor or basement?

scenes.title: 🚪 Escape Route
scenes.narrative:
You locate an emergency exit route.

🚨 Sirens begin echoing through the building.

scenes.title: 🚨 Alarm Triggered
scenes.narrative:
Red lights flash across the halls.

🚨 Alarms scream as security closes in fast.

scenes.title: 👏 Perfect Heist
scenes.narrative:
You disable the building's security completely.

💾 You walk away with full access and zero traces.

A perfect job.

scenes.title: 🌙 Escape
scenes.narrative:
You disappear into the neon night.

🌆 You didn't get everything… but you made it out alive.

scenes.title: 🛑 Trace Complete
scenes.narrative:
The download finishes.

So does the trace.

🚪 Security bursts into the room.

You're caught.

scenes.title: 🔥 Chaos Unleashed
scenes.narrative:
The creature escapes containment.

💥 It tears through the building as alarms erupt everywhere.

In the chaos, you slip away.

Neon City will never be the same.

scenes.title: ☠️ Overwhelmed
scenes.narrative:
You try to fight back.

But Helix security is too strong.

The mission ends here.
